s2.ptxt: Install a new exhaust manifold to head gasket to the cylinder head.
Temporarily install the exhaust manifold converter to the cylinder head with the 5 nuts.
Fully tighten the nuts in the order shown in the illustration.
Install manifold stay No.2 with the bolt and nut.
Install the manifold stay with the bolt and nut.
Using SST, install the air fuel ratio sensor to the exhaust manifold.
Install the air fuel ratio sensor connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Exhaust Manifold Heat Insulator NO.1

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust manifold heat insulator No.1 with 4 bolts.
Install a new O-ring to the oil level gauge guide.
Apply engine oil to the O-ring and install the oil level gauge guide with the bolt.
Install the oil level gauge.
Compression Spring Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a vernier caliper, measure the free length of the compression spring.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust manifold converter as far as it goes by hand.
Using a wooden block and hammer, gradually tap in the gasket until it is flush with the exhaust manifold.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe FR.

s2.ptxt: Connect the exhaust pipe FR with the 2 bolts and 2 compression springs.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the clearance between the flanges of the exhaust manifold converter and exhaust pipe assembly FR is equal at the front, rear, left and right.

s2.ptxt: Install the exhaust pipe assembly FR with the 2 bolts.
Connect the oxygen sensor connector.
Check that the crankshaft position sensor wire harness is securely fitted into the wire harness clamp bracket and passes behind the rib of the timing chain cover.
Install the Alternator with the 2 bolts.
Install the harness clamp.
Install the clamp bracket with the bolt.
Connect the harness to the +B terminal with the nut.
Install the terminal cap.
Connect the connector.

atten4.ptxt: When reusing the belt, inspect the entire circumference of the ribs and back for wear and cracks, and replace it if wear or cracks reach the core (1 or more places) or if the rib rubber is chipped (1 or more places).

s2.ptxt: Using SST, slowly turn the V-belt tensioner clockwise and install the V-belt.

item.ptxt: Check that the SST and tools are securely set.
When compressing the V-belt tensioner, slowly apply force perpendicular to the tool, taking 3 seconds or more.

s2.ptxt: Check that the belt is fitted on each pulley.
Check that the belt is correctly set on each pulley.
Start the engine and check that the belt rotates smoothly with no abnormal noise.
Install the radiator upper air deflector with the 8 clips.
Install the engine under cover No.1 with the 6 bolts and 7 clips.

s-1.ptxt: Install Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Install the engine under cover rear RH with the 5 clips.
Check that there are no exhaust gas leaks from the locations shown in the illustration (exhaust pipe joints and each sensor installation area).
